metadata.title: Dennis Landaverde — Software Engineer
metadata.description: Full stack Software Engineer. I build interfaces with Angular and React, services with Java and Quarkus, and enterprise systems on Oracle Database and JD Edwards.
metadata.keywords: Dennis Landaverde, Software Engineer, Full Stack Developer, Angular, React, TypeScript, Java, Quarkus, Oracle Database, JD Edwards, El Salvador

hero.title: Welcome
hero.tagline: I turn ideas into fast, accessible digital products built to last.

about.body: Full stack software engineer. I build interfaces with Angular and React and back them with services in Java and Quarkus. On the enterprise side I work with Oracle Database and JD Edwards, where the challenge is not just writing code but understanding the business process behind it.

highlights.focusBody: Every technical decision is judged by what it gives the person using the product, not by what is trending.
highlights.qualityBody: Strict typing, reviews and tests: code someone else can still maintain a year from now.
highlights.performanceBody: Loading budgets, optimized images and only the JavaScript the browser actually needs.

skills.subtitle: What I work with, from the browser to the database.

web.title: Web development
web.description: Responsive, accessible and search-optimized applications and websites.

database.title: Databases
database.description: Schema design, efficient queries and data integrity.

projects.subtitle: A selection of what I have built.

clinicplus.title: ClinicPlus
clinicplus.description: Patient management and medical appointment scheduling platform. Front end built with Next.js 16 App Router, React 19 and Tailwind CSS, with separate portals for patients and clinical staff. The back end (NestJS, PostgreSQL and Prisma) lives in a separate repository.
clinicplus.imageAlt: Cover image for ClinicPlus, a clinic management platform

portfolio.title: Personal portfolio
portfolio.description: This very site: Next.js 16, React 19 and strict TypeScript, bilingual, with validated environment variables and hardened security headers.
